keyword.en: which concrete pump lists 6 cm aggregate
keyword.zh: 哪台混凝土泵印了6厘米骨料

title.en: What 6 cm Aggregate Is Printed lists, with Ground granulated blast-furnace slag as the illustration
title.zh: 6厘米骨料印在哪些泵上列出的内容，用「Ground granulated blast-furnace slag」做插图

description.en: 6 cm Aggregate Is Printed. 6 cm and below stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Ground granulated blast-furnace slag.
description.zh: 6厘米骨料印在哪些泵上。6 cm and below仍在目录格子里。插图来自「Ground granulated blast-furnace slag」。

h1.en: What 6 cm Aggregate Is Printed lists, with Ground granulated blast-furnace slag as the illustration
h1.zh: 6厘米骨料印在哪些泵上列出的内容，用「Ground granulated blast-furnace slag」做插图

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists maximum aggregate size 6 cm and below on two concrete pumps in Xingtai: LZ-80 and Diesel 120. LZ-60 lists 4 cm and below. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground_granulated_blast-furnace_slag.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵上标出了最大骨料 6 cm 及以下：LZ-80 和柴油120。规格表没有骨料行的页面，例如柴油40，不会默认得到 6 cm。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground_granulated_blast-furnace_slag。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground_granulated_blast-furnace_slag: Samples of "ground granulated blast furnace slag" and "granulated blast furnace slag". Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists maximum aggregate size 6 cm and below on two concrete pumps in Xingtai: LZ-80 and Diesel 120. The 6 cm entry is not a family rule for every diesel pump. Same aggregate wording, different machines. Hebei Pinjin Machinery keeps those wordings on their own pages.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground_granulated_blast-furnace_slag页上的Samples of "ground granulated blast furnace slag" and "granulated blast furnace slag"。河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵上标出了最大骨料 6 cm 及以下：LZ-80 和柴油120。HBT8018 和搅拌泵一体机标出 4 cm 及以下。

body.en: LZ-60 lists 4 cm and below. A page without an aggregate row, such as Diesel 40's specification table, does not receive 6 cm by default. HBT8018 and the integrated mixer list 4 cm and below. Diesel 40, Diesel 50 and Diesel 60 do not list a maximum-aggregate row in the specification table.
body.zh: 规格表没有骨料行的页面，例如柴油40，不会默认得到 6 cm。B500S-83D 把适用材料写成 5–16 mm。

body.en: Diesel 30 lists 3 cm and below. LZ-80 pairs 6 cm and below with a Yuchai 256 kW engine and two pressure ceilings. Electric 20 lists 1–2 cm. Do not fill them with 6 cm.
body.zh: LZ-80 把 6 cm 及以下和玉柴 256 kW 以及两档压力上限放在一起。柴油40、柴油50和柴油60的规格表没有最大骨料行。

body.en: Electric 80 lists 24 mm (≤ 2 cm). Diesel 120 pairs it with 290 kW from two 145 kW units and 100 m³/h. B500S-83D lists 5–16 mm as applicable materials. Confirm a mix through /en/contact/.
body.zh: 柴油120把它和两台 145 kW 合计 290 kW、产量 100 m³/h 放在一起。配合比请通过 /zh/contact/ 确认。

question.en: Which models list 6 cm and below?
question.zh: 哪些型号标出 6 cm 及以下？

answer.en: LZ-80 and Diesel 120. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground_granulated_blast-furnace_slag.
answer.zh: LZ-80 和柴油120。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground_granulated_blast-furnace_slag画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. LZ-60 lists 4 cm and below. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground_granulated_blast-furnace_slag.
answer.zh: 没有。LZ-60 标出 4 cm 及以下。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground_granulated_blast-furnace_slag画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: Its specification table does not list an aggregate size. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground_granulated_blast-furnace_slag.
answer.zh: 它的规格表没有标出骨料粒径。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground_granulated_blast-furnace_slag画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is 6 cm the same as 24 mm?
question.zh: 6 cm 和 24 mm 一样吗？

answer.en: No. 24 mm (≤ 2 cm) is the Electric 80 entry. 6 cm and below is a different shown entry. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground_granulated_blast-furnace_slag.
answer.zh: 不一样。24 mm（≤ 2 cm）是电动80的格子。6 cm 及以下是另一个写出的格子。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ground_granulated_blast-furnace_slag画面里印出的数字。
